title.purpose: Section headings and hover card titles.

body.purpose: Row values; a row's name is weight 500.

label.purpose: Buttons, column headers, footers and key hints.

micro.purpose: Initials inside a person mark and the smallest button's label; never running text.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Hover cards, menus and peek panels, on the popover layer (z-index 50); nothing in the page flow casts a shadow.

motion.name: duration-quick
motion.purpose: Opening a floating layer such as the field card.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Easing for a layer that opens.

motion.name: preview-card-enter-scale
motion.purpose: The field card's starting scale; closing is instant and reduced motion disables it.

breakpoints.name: abbreviate
breakpoints.purpose: Container width below which a list row or table column shows its short form.

breakpoints.name: hide
breakpoints.purpose: Container width below which a list row or table column marked to hide disappears.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one accent-filled control; marks the action the caller can take.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 0.6); background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 0.75rem/1.625 "Mona Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 30%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A secondary action with no fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 0.6); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font: 500 0.75rem/1.625 "Mona Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 30%, transparent); }

components.name: List Row
components.description: One record: rank 1 subject, then rank 2 facts; 44px, no line between rows, a floor-radius tint on hover and focus.
components.html: INV-1042Harbour Freight Ltd$12,480.00
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 0.6); color: var(--foreground); font: 400 0.875rem/1.43 "Mona Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 4%, transparent); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: none; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 4%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 40%, transparent); } .ds-row-key { color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-row-name { font-weight: 500; } .ds-row-read { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; }

components.name: Table Row
components.description: One record in a table: 44px, square, no line between rows, a tint on hover and focus, a group row at 36px on a quiet fill above its records, a header on a quiet fill rounded at its top corners, a click anywhere following its link.
components.html:
InvoiceAmount
Overdue$12,480.00
INV-1042$12,480.00
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font: 400 0.875rem/1.43 "Mona Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { padding: 0 8px; text-align: left; white-space: nowrap; vertical-align: middle; } .ds-table thead th { height: 36px; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-table tr { position: relative; isolation: isolate; } .ds-table tr > :first-child::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none; } .ds-table thead tr > :first-child::before { border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 0.6) calc(var(--radius) * 0.6) 0 0; background: var(--muted); } .ds-table-row { height: 44px; } .ds-table-row:hover > :first-child::before { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 4%, transparent); } .ds-table-row:focus-visible { outline: none; } .ds-table-row:focus-visible > :first-child::before { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 7%, transparent); } .ds-table-group { height: 36px; } .ds-table-group > :first-child::before { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted) 40%, transparent); } .ds-table-group:focus-visible > :first-child::before { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--ring); } .ds-table-end { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-table-group { height: 44px; } }

components.name: Preview Card
components.description: Rank 4 hover card on one entity's trigger; its radius is its content's radius plus its padding.
components.html:
Dana Whitfield

Accounts payable, Sydney
components.css: .ds-preview-card { width: 240px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 0.6 + 12px); background: var(--popover); color: var(--popover-foreground); font: 400 0.75rem/1.33 "Mona Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05), 0 10px 28px -8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18); } .ds-preview-card p { margin: 4px 0 8px; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-preview-card-action { height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 0.6); background: transparent; font: inherit; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Status
components.description: A state as a shape and a name, readable in greyscale.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--foreground); font: 400 0.875rem/1.43 "Mona Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Entity
components.description: Initials or a picture in a quiet circle, then the name.
components.css: .ds-person { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.43 "Mona Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-person-initials { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--muted); color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: List Row Icon Media
components.description: One muted icon for the record's kind, with no fill behind it, between the ID and the name; its label names it for screen readers.
components.css: .ds-list-row-media-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-list-row-media-icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

components.name: Selection Bar
components.description: Floats at the bottom while records are selected: the count, at most two actions, a more menu and Clear, padded 4px with the lg radius (10px).
components.html: 2 selected
components.css: .ds-bar { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, var(--radius)); background: var(--background); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05), 0 10px 28px -8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18); font: 400 0.875rem/1.43 "Mona Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-bar-count { padding: 0 10px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-bar-divider { width: 1px; height: 16px; margin: 0 4px; background: var(--border); } .ds-bar-btn { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 0.6); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font: inherit; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-bar-btn:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-bar-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-bar-clear { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-bar-clear:hover { color: var(--foreground); }

narrative.overview: The system is defined by the relationships between components, not by the components alone: how data is ranked, which parts fit into which slots, which components render on which surface, which sit next to each other, how much space separates one type from another, and how a radius builds outward from its content. Each component encodes the relationships it takes part in, so callers assemble new surfaces freely and every assembly stays consistent. The palette is monochrome with one orange that marks only what can be acted on; density is high and depth is flat. Four principles decide any case no rule covers, in this order: Quiet, Clear, Precise and Sleek.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet, Clear, Precise and Sleek, in that order, decide what the rules do not.
Components declare which components they contain, sit beside and sit inside.
One accent, used only on actionable elements and the focus ring.
44px rows with 24×24px hit areas that grow to 44×44px on a coarse pointer.
State shown by shape and word, never by colour alone; a shape drawn alone discloses its word.
Rows separated by nothing; a hover, focus or peek tint marks a row. A list and a table draw no surface of their own; shadows only on floating layers.
Revealed controls appear on hover, focus and selection, and are always visible on a coarse pointer.
Chrome is thin: a bar or menu adds 4px around its controls, so a bar of 32px buttons is 42px high.

rules.name: The Quiet Rule
rules.body: Nothing draws at rest that the caller does not need at rest; what they need only sometimes is revealed on hover, focus or selection.

rules.name: The Clear Rule
rules.body: Every value carries its meaning: a figure names its unit, a state shows its word, a control names its action. Clear overrules Quiet.

rules.name: The Precise Rule
rules.body: Every part sits in the column and on the edge it belongs to.

rules.name: The Sleek Rule
rules.body: A container is no thicker than its contents need: 4px of padding around controls, 12px around content.

rules.name: The Act-Only Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal Orange appears only on something the caller can act on, or on the focus ring.

rules.name: The No-Colour-Alone Rule
rules.body: A state is carried by a shape and a word, so it reads in greyscale. A shape drawn alone keeps its word in the accessible name and discloses it on hover, and by keyboard through peek or the record's page.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number compared down a column uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the page casts a shadow at rest; a shadow means the layer floats and will close.

rules.name: The Outward Radius Rule
rules.body: A container's radius is its content's radius plus its padding, so a container never picks a radius on its own.

dos: **Do** take every colour, radius, spacing, type, shadow, motion, layer and breakpoint value from a token; tokens are authored in `registry/tokens` and generated into `registry/styles/tokens.gen.css` and `theme.gen.css`.
**Do** derive a container's radius from its content's radius plus its padding.
**Do** pad a container of controls by 4px with `{rounded.lg}`, and a container of content by 12px with `{rounded.card}`.
**Do** name a figure's unit in its column header, such as Amount (AUD).
**Do** let the container set the gap between its children from `--spacing-run`, `--spacing-related` or `--spacing-section`.
**Do** keep row actions hidden until hover, focus or selection, and always visible on a coarse pointer.
**Do** give every hit area at least 24×24px, and 44×44px on a coarse pointer.
**Do** use tabular figures for any number compared down a column.
donts: **Don't** draw a line, border, fill or hint at rest that the caller does not need at rest.
**Don't** use Signal Orange on anything the caller cannot act on.
**Don't** show a state by colour alone, or draw a shape alone that does not disclose its word.
**Don't** put a shadow on a surface that sits in the page flow.
**Don't** add a second typeface; use Mona Sans weights and widths.
**Don't** give a component margin or a hard-coded radius; both come from its container.
**Don't** write an untokenised value such as `text-[0.625rem]`, `z-50` or `duration-150` in a published component; add a token instead.
